notes.title: Update Base AI Model
notes.notes: [p]I've updated the base AI model, which has nearly doubled the processing speed and reduced VRAM usage. [/p][p]In exchange, there has been a slight decrease in accuracy, but we plan to continue fine-tuning this.[/p]

notes.title: Add Shapes Control and Translation Update
notes.notes: [p]I have updated the demo version as below;[/p][p][/p][h3]Add Shapes Control in Main Game Scene[/h3][list][*][p]You can command about shapes for some operations, such as "Cut out", "Cut at angle" and so on.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Translation Update[/h3][list][*][p]Translation is updated. In particular, the translation of narrative text has been updated to sound more natural.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Release and Notice
notes.notes: [p]The demo version was released on July 2, 2025![/p][p]You can play up to stage 2 of easy mode, so please give it a try![/p][p][/p][p][b]2025/8/15 Update[/b][/p][p]In response to the comments, I have made the following updates.[/p][p]- Added a feature to check ingredients purchased and used[/p][p]- Added a feature to check skills acquired and used[/p][p]- Added a feature to sort ingredients and skills[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused cooking class ingredients to be mixed with ingredients currently in your possession[/p][p]- Other minor fixes[/p][p][/p][p][b]2025/7/16 Update[/b][/p][p]In response to the comments, I have made the following updates.[/p][p]- Added a feature that allows AI to generate an appropriate name when the recipe name is blank[/p][p]- Tutorial improvements[/p][p]- Addressed an issue where text was not advanced, particularly in the English version, causing the text to be cut off[/p][p]- Displays the number of days remaining until the weekend[/p][p]- Fixed the position of the "steps" during cooking to make them easier to select[/p][p]- Other minor fixes[/p][p][/p][p][b]2025/7/14  Update[/b][/p][p]fix minor typo.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2025/7/9 Update[/b][/p][p]Update to register ingredients of the recipes into  official web site.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2025/7/3 Important Update[/b][/p][p]Due to problems with the initial build, it was updated on July 3 at 4:00 UTC/13:00 JST.[/p][p]Please check this version if it didn't work with the version before the update.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you will continue to support "COOK MY MEAL GRANDPA!"[/p]
